desc: View product details for Odd ID and add valid quantity (Nominal Path)
expected: Product detail page renders. Success alert 'Đã thêm vào giỏ hàng' appears. Cart counter increments.
actual: Rendered successfully. Success alert popped up. Cart counter became Giỏ (1) representing unique products.

desc: View product details for Even ID and add default quantity (Data Formatting Path)
expected: Product detail page renders. Price formatted as 28,000,000 ₫. Success alert appears. Cart increments.
actual: Price string parsed back to number successfully and shown as 28,000,000 ₫. Success alert popped up.

expected: Returns empty object {} from API. Client shows blank state page error message.
actual: API returns {} and SUT shows 'Sản phẩm không tồn tại (Lỗi trắng trang do data rỗng)'. Verified via code inspection and API query.

desc: Add product to cart with quantity of zero (SUT validation flaw)
expected: Rejected with error validation alert 'Số lượng phải lớn hơn 0'.
actual: Silently normalizes quantity to 1 and adds item to cart with success alert.

desc: Add product to cart with negative quantity (SUT validation flaw)
expected: Rejected with error validation alert 'Số lượng phải lớn hơn 0'.
actual: Silently normalizes quantity to 1 and adds item to cart with success alert.

desc: Add product to cart with decimal quantity (SUT truncation)
expected: Blocked or rounded to nearest integer with warning.
actual: Truncates 2.5 to 2 via parseInt, adds 2 items to cart with success alert.

desc: Add product to cart with non-numeric quantity (SUT validation flaw)
actual: Silently normalizes blank/alphabetic quantity to 1 and adds to cart with success alert.

desc: Add product to cart with exceptionally large quantity
expected: Rejected with maximum purchase limit error.
actual: Accepts 999999999999 raw, causing floating-point total price calculation in cart and layout breakage.
